items.headline: Carlos Baleba makes first United appearance in behind-closed-doors friendly
items.summary: Summer signing Baleba played his opening minutes for United in friendly vs Lausanne-Sport on Friday after recovering from ankle injury sustained at Brighton.

items.headline: Bruno Fernandes and Patrick Dorgu sidelined by injuries during international break
items.summary: Captain Fernandes withdrawn from Portugal duty after playing through pain; Dorgu removed from Denmark squad with ankle problem, clouding United's preparations for Tottenham.

items.headline: Manchester United consider legal action if JJ Gabriel departs for elite European club
items.summary: Club weighing response to academy prospect Gabriel's potential exit, with Bayern Munich, Barcelona and Real Madrid reportedly interested in 19-year-old talent.

items.headline: David Raum linked with January move as left-back target
items.summary: RB Leipzig captain reportedly open to Premier League move; United pursuing the 28-year-old German as cover for injury-prone Luke Shaw with release clause mechanism.

items.headline: Manchester United planning defensive overhaul for 2027 amid early season concerns
items.summary: Michael Carrick voiced concerns about centre-back options; club stepping up efforts to reinforce backline next summer following slow Premier League start.
